status: frozen before any sealed outcome value was read by the model developer
context_of_use: U1 initial-state prediction of a new study's control-group mean intraocular pressure (fraction of its preoperative IOP) at the study's follow-up months after a glaucoma procedure, from species, procedure, series kind and the preoperative IOP only
U2 causal forecasting of each group mean's next follow-up (control and treated groups) from its own earlier follow-ups
U3 landmark forecasting of every later follow-up of each group mean from its first postoperative measurement only
not_claimed: biological mechanism validation (aqueous production and outflow are not modelled)
single-eye prediction (development next observation: 19.58 pp against persistence 19.17, coverage 0.574/0.685)
treatment-effect prediction (treated groups use the control prior of their context)
surgical success or failure, success thresholds, hypotony or pressure-spike events
medication-adjusted pressure (most preoperative references are medicated; postoperative medication is not modelled)
contexts without a training study except through the species-mean fallback
non-human species (all 47 development records are human)
tonometer equivalence (fractions are taken within each series' method)
cohorts selected by outcome or censored at reoperation (excluded at extraction)

model.kinetics: ln f(t) = ell + e r(t), r(t) = exp(-(t - t1)/tau), t1 = 1 day, t in months, f = IOP / preoperative IOP; ell = context level + b x with x = ln(IOP0 / 20 mmHg)
model.hierarchy: one hierarchy per species (species/all): species mean of (level, e, ln tau), shared level slope b on x as a fixed effect estimated by GLS inside REML, procedure context effect, study effect and series deviation (separate for group means and single eyes); diagonal covariances by penalized REML (Gamma(2) SD modes 0.1, 0.1, 0.5) on per-series likelihood-information summaries (weak prior N(0,1) on level and e, near-uniform ln tau, subtracted; directions below 0.05 weak-prior precisions carry no weight)
model.computation: given ln tau the law is linear in (level, e): exact Gaussian posteriors on an 80-point tau grid 0.01..120 months, mixtures over noise levels, Student-t scale-mixture nodes (16) and robust components; quantiles from the exact mixture CDF
model.observation: Gaussian noise in ln f; SD per (study, species family, series kind) from best fits of series with >=4 follow-ups; a new study's SD marginalized over log-normal(log-SD 0.5) around the family/kind median, floor 0.01
model.fallback: a procedure absent from training uses the species mean with the context variance added; a species with <2 training studies has no population prior
model.forecasting: population_assimilation_robust: population Gaussian prior mixed 0.8/0.2 with a broad component (SD 0.3, 0.3, 2.0 added), exact posterior given the prefix
model.point_forecast: median of the posterior predictive distribution of the observation (0.5 quantile), for every population variant and task
development_changes_before_freeze: round 0 (in-sample, development series with >=4 follow-ups): exponential return adopted over hyperbolic and power 0.5/2 laws (group-mean dof-adjusted log-SD 0.0682 vs 0.0716/0.0760/0.0698)

round 0 structural choices: one hierarchy per species without mechanism families (lesson of the thickness model's laser-capsulotomy failure); shared level slope on ln(IOP0/20) because postoperative pressure regresses toward a common target (in-sample slope -0.765)

round 1 LOSO (posterior-mean point forecasts): robust next-observation 9.45 pp, landmark 13.38 pp; Student-t variants exploded (anchored_t4 landmark max 480 pp) because the mean of exp of a Student-t variable does not exist

round 2 LOSO (predictive-median point forecasts, declared before the run, adopted by the declared rule): robust next-observation 9.455 pp, landmark 13.389 pp; primary chosen by the rule declared before round 1 (t4 9.511, 0.056 pp behind)
context of use restricted to group means after development showed single-eye forecasts worse than persistence and under-covered

methods.secondary_U3: same set as U2, all from the first follow-up only
methods.selection_rule: declared before round 1: lowest pooled development next-observation RMSE among population variants with next-observation coverage inside both windows; ties within 0.05 pp to the simpler variant

training: all 47 development records (101 series; 54 reserved development studies minus 7 without a record: medians only, outcome-selected or censored sets, fellow-eye controls, percent reductions); controls with a preoperative IOP fit the population, all series give noise and analog-library inputs; for each sealed study the development studies linked to it by the author-overlap rule are removed from its training set

excluded_by_custodians.iop-pmc10471744: censored at additional surgery (outcome-selected analysis set)
excluded_by_custodians.iop-pmc6680218: censored at additional surgery (outcome-selected analysis set)
excluded_by_custodians.iop-pmc12858626: censored at additional surgery or outcome-selected
excluded_by_custodians.iop-pmc13059178: censored at additional surgery or outcome-selected
excluded_by_custodians.iop-pmc12932313: censored at additional surgery or outcome-selected
excluded_by_custodians.iop-pmc9880568: values limited to eyes that needed no further intervention

sealed_test.custodians: three separate sub-agents (S1, S2, S3) extracted the sealed records and reported only structure and hashes
sealed_test.structure_seen_before_freeze: the developer saw the custodians' structural summaries only: 25 records, 68 series (44 group means, 24 single eyes; 53 control, 15 treated); contexts human/angle_mims 18, human/cyclodestruction 17, human/tube 17, human/trabeculectomy 9, human/cataract 3, human/nonpenetrating 2, human/subconjunctival_mims 2 (all with development training studies); value kind iop_absolute throughout; methods, reference kinds and licence classes; no IOP value. A structural load check printed only these counts and that 14 series have fewer than two follow-ups

criteria.per_series_U2: RMSE<=5 pp AND max<=10 pp AND RMSE at least 0.5 pp below persistence
criteria.per_series_U3: RMSE<=5 pp AND max<=10 pp AND RMSE at least 0.5 pp below persistence (first follow-up carried forward)
criteria.unit: percentage points of each series' preoperative IOP
criteria.tested_subset: group means (U2, U3) and control group means (U1)
criteria.H1_calibration: pooled population_assimilation_robust next-observation coverage over group means: 80% interval within [0.70,0.90] AND 90% interval within [0.80,0.97]
criteria.H2_accuracy: pooled next-observation RMSE of population_assimilation_robust over group means lower than each of persistence, last_two_log_linear, pooled_curve_ratio and analog_knn over common targets
criteria.H3_landmark: pooled landmark RMSE of population_assimilation_robust over group means lower than each of persistence, pooled_curve_ratio and analog_knn over common targets; landmark coverage reported
criteria.H4_initial_state: pooled RMSE of population_initial_state over control group means lower than pooled_training_curve; per-group criterion counts and coverage reported
criteria.reported_not_tested: single eyes in every task, all-series pooled values and coverage, treated groups, per-context results, controls-only counts, comparisons with reference_to_last_log_linear and preoperative_level (f = 1)
criteria.all_points: every sealed series/target is scored; none removed; thresholds unchanged after unsealing
